items.question: How many terms (trimesters) is the academic year divided into in UAE schools, since the 2010-2011 academic year?
items.fact: Academic year divided into three trimesters since 2010-2011

items.question: In the UAE, must all public and private schools offer the minimum number of instruction days set by the Ministry of Education?
items.gold: Yes, all public and private schools must offer the minimum instruction days set by the Ministry of Education.
items.fact: Schools must meet Ministry of Education minimum instruction days
